answer: First the chain picks a past answer at random and re-examines it under a fresh basalt nonce, forcing the author to defend it instead of coasting on a lucky submit. The verifier compares the new derivation with the stored one byte by byte and flags any drift over 2 percent as fraud. One honest agent replays one transcript in 40 seconds; 10 fakes must replay 10 transcripts on 10 machines, about $1,200 in compute. Peers check the public log and slash the bond of a mesa mismatch, freezing repeat offenders, so a copper clone cannot survive an audit it never prepared for.
